info.name: CoworkingView
info.summary: Search flexible workspaces by city and type
info.description:
Search coworking spaces and flexible offices from the public CoworkingView catalogue without leaving Nextcloud.
The dashboard widget filters by city and workspace type. Each match shows the workspace name, the city, the workspace type and a link to the listing on coworkingview.com. Unified Search can look up a workspace by name, or a city by its name, after you enable search of connected services.
The app does not store prices, photos or descriptions. Listings stay on coworkingview.com.
